name: Render Budget Focused Asset Review Rubric
purpose: Prioritizes assets that preserve frame budget, capture stability, and review clarity under heavier simulation loads.

criteria.description: Assets should remain recognizable even when simplified for performance.
Materials should use efficient color, roughness, and emission cues instead of expensive detail.
Collision and navigation boundaries should remain stable under dense routing scenarios.
Assets should still emit meaningful review signals without requiring heavy debug rendering.
The asset should demonstrate strong visual return for low mesh, material, and capture cost.
